parameters.RouteEntry::__construct: RouteEntry is the route value object: methods, pattern and handler plus six optional fields, each independent and set by named argument. A Parameter Object would only wrap RouteEntry itself (Spec V4.3.3 §13; QD §3).
parameters.Route::__construct: The #[Route] attribute mirrors RouteEntry's optional fields; PHP passes attribute arguments only through the constructor, by name.
parameters.RouteRegistry::route: Named-argument builder over RouteEntry's fields; addRoute(new RouteEntry(...)) is the Parameter Object form of the same call.
parameters.RouteGroup::map: The group form of RouteRegistry::route(), with the same fields, so a group can set defaults and metadata too.
